question: Does this pair of papers inside one displayed card describe different research tasks, objects or mechanisms, so that the whole card cannot be treated as one verified narrow line?

decisions.reason: Self-positioning of the UAV versus localizing a target object in aerial images.
Mission generation from satellite imagery versus semantic navigation and artistic agency of a flying installation.
Safety-filtered UAV pursuit versus RL path planning used to estimate airspace capacity.
Vision-based racing with human attention prediction versus monocular landing using a lenticular pad.
Remote-ID collision avoidance for multi-drone operations versus single-UAV medical-delivery trajectory optimization with temporal logic.
Actual UAV swarm navigation versus computational study of Brownian particles; drones are only one possible application of the latter.
Estimate the drone's own position and velocity versus tracking another object when detections are intermittent.
Coded distributed convolution in airborne computing versus wireless scheduling of federated-learning parameters.
Spiking-network attitude control of a quadrotor versus EEG-based fatigue classification of human pilots.
Real-time trajectory planner for a quadrotor versus aerodynamic design and modeling of a morphing airframe.
Detection of radio jamming versus zero-knowledge flight-path authentication and privacy.

Both belong to RIS-assisted UAV communications, but one optimizes a passive IRS link under jamming and the other a STAR-RIS multi-user sum rate. This pair supports a parent family, not a proven single narrow task/mechanism.
PV-module inspection and tracking versus wilderness search for human survivors.
Human-detection benchmark with pose metadata versus active image capture for individual wildlife re-identification.
LiDAR semantic SLAM and autonomous under-canopy flight versus photogrammetric reconstruction parameter study for rooftops.

limitations: A contrast pair disproves treating an entire card as one established narrow task, but does not partition every article in that card.
One developer selected the pairs and interpreted abstracts. This is not independent expert quality or Precision@15.
The rank-12 RIS/STAR-RIS boundary is especially judgment-sensitive; a broader parent family may still be useful as navigation.
